name: CreateIpv4Gateway

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPv4 gateway.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
创建的IPv4网关的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: ipv4_gateway_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the IPv4 gateway.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
创建的IPv4网关的描述信息。

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: ipv4_gateway_description

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC in which you want to create the IPv4 gateway.

You can create only one IPv4 gateway in a VPC
parameters.help_zh:
创建的IPv4网关所在VPC的ID。

一个VPC仅支持创建一个IPv4网关
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the IPv4 gateway is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建IPv4网关。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接创建IPv4网关
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPv4 gateway.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
创建IPv4网关的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:

fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
